libraryMenu.title: Library
libraryMenu.help_makeYourOwn: To get started, drag elements from your drawing onto the library to add them. You can then drag them back from your library onto the canvas to reuse them. And that’s it!
libraryMenu.help_screenshot: You can take a screenshot of your drawing to use as a cover for your library item. First select the elements you’d like to use as a cover, then in the context menu choose 'Use as screenshot'.
libraryMenu.help_publish: To publish your library to the world, click on the publish button. This will allow others to find it and use its content in their drawings.
libraryMenu.help_browse: Want to see what others have made? You can browse the public libraries and import their content to use in your drawings.
libraryMenu.help_findMore: You can find more information about the library feature, such as how to publish a library, in our documentation.
libraryMenu.help_order: Library items are ordered chronologically. Newest items are added at the beginning. You can reorder items by dragging them.
libraryMenu.help_orderForPublished: For published libraries, items are ordered by how they are sorted when publishing a new version. To reorder items in a published library, sort them and publish the library again.
libraryMenu.confirmLoad: This will replace your existing library. Do you want to continue?
libraryMenu.confirmReset: This will remove your library. Are you sure?
libraryMenu.confirmAddToLibrary: Add to your library? This will merge the items in your library.
